metadata.description: Test cases for module and package validation

literal.string: valid camelCase term def: no error
valid single-letter term def: no error
underscore in term def name: error
definition with matching namespace: no error
two definitions in order: no error
two definitions out of order: error
uppercase first letter of segment: error
single package, distinct namespaces: no error
two packages, distinct namespaces: no error
same package repeats a namespace: not this check's concern, no error
two packages declare the same namespace: error
three packages, one namespace collides between the first two: single finding
sibling namespaces sharing a common (non-module) prefix, no nesting: no error
string-prefix but not dotted: no error (hydra.foo is not a prefix of hydra.foobar)
dotted-prefix nesting: error (outer defined before inner)
dotted-prefix nesting: error (inner defined before outer)
single module, no references: no error
declared dependency covers the reference: no error
#555 regression: reference to another module's symbol with no declared dependency: error
transitive-only dependency does not satisfy one-hop: error
reference to a name with no known owner (e.g. a typo): no error
reference to a primitive name: excluded, no error
self-reference within the same module: no error
multi-error accumulation: two distinct rules produce two findings
warning classification: both rules demoted to warnings
rule disabling: duplicate-name rule omitted from profile
maxErrors bound: only first rule collected when maxErrors=1
